verses.1: The Lord detests dishonest scales, but He delights in a true weight.
verses.2: When arrogance comes in, disgrace follows, but with the humble comes wisdom.
verses.3: The upright person’s truthfulness protects them, but the deceiver’s self-interest ensnares them.
verses.4: Wealth will not help on the day of wrath, but righteousness rescues from death.
verses.5: The righteousness of the innocent straightens their path, but in their wickedness, the wicked stumble.
verses.6: The righteousness of the upright saves them, but the deceitfulness of the wicked traps them.
verses.7: When a wicked man dies, hope is lost, and the pride of sinners vanishes.
verses.8: The righteous are delivered from trouble, but the wicked fall into it.
verses.9: With a deceitful mouth, one destroys a companion, but the understanding of the righteous saves.
verses.10: By the goodness of the righteous, a city is exalted, and by the downfall of the wicked, there is rejoicing.
verses.11: By the blessing of the upright, the city is raised, but by the mouth of the wicked, it is torn down.
verses.12: One who belittles a companion lacks sense, but a person of understanding keeps quiet.
verses.13: A gossiping person reveals secrets, but a trustworthy spirit conceals a matter.
verses.14: Without guidance, a people will fall, but in many counselors, there is safety.
verses.15: Woe to the one who guarantees for a stranger, and to the one who puts up security for a foe.
verses.16: A woman of worth supports honor, but the violent cling to wealth.
verses.17: One who shows kindness to themselves is a person of loyalty, but one who withholds favor is cruel.
verses.18: A wicked person does deeds of falsehood, but one who sows righteousness reaps truth.
verses.19: Just as righteousness leads to life, so the one who pursues evil pursues death.
verses.20: The Lord detests crooked hearts, but He delights in those who are blameless in their ways.
verses.21: The wicked will not escape punishment, hand in hand, but the seed of the righteous will be saved.
verses.22: Like a nose ring in a pig’s snout, so is beauty in a woman without sense.
verses.23: The desire of the righteous is always good, but the hope of the wicked is wrongdoing.
verses.24: There are those who scatter and yet gain more, and those who withhold too much end in need.
verses.25: The soul that blesses is satisfied, and one who waters will also be watered.
verses.26: One who withholds grain will be cursed, but the blessing rests on the head of the one who shares.
verses.27: One who seeks good pursues favor, but one who seeks evil will encounter it.
verses.28: One who trusts in wealth will fall, but the righteous will flourish like a green shoot.
verses.29: One who neglects their household inherits the wind, but a foolish servant becomes a wise man’s heir.
verses.30: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and the one who takes lives is a wise man.
verses.31: Even the righteous who live on earth will be put to death, let alone the wicked and the sinner.

notes:
Notes
- v. 29: "The one who takes lives is a wise man" reflects a challenging interpretation of the Hebrew, where the meaning is opaque. The phrase likely contrasts the "wise man" with the one who neglects his family, but the precise connection is uncertain.
- v. 31: The reading "Even the righteous who live on earth will be put to death, let alone the wicked and the sinner" is a literal translation of the difficult Hebrew, which may be a proverbial expression of the fate of the wicked.
